items.author: Leo S
items.body_excerpt:
The Iowa Wolves desperately need Rocco Zikarsky. I already belabored the point about them literally have 0 big men. My goal for Rocco was play 30+ mpg in Iowa so he'll have all the opportunity he can get now...

Isaiah Evans is also going to get A LOT of shots up. Iowa has plenty of passers!

images.alt: NEWS: Timberwolves transfer center Rocco Zikarsky and assign guard Isaiah Evans to G League affiliate Iowa Wolves.
